div.head: V As Prol., 1
div.ab: Nu hæbbe ic funden mid ðæm witum, þe mid me wæron æt Eaxanceastre to middanwintre, ðæt þa ealle beon gearwe mid him silfum ⁊ mid wife ⁊ mid ærfe ⁊ mid eallum þingum to farenne ðider ic wille—buton hy ofer þis geswican willan—on þa gerad þæt hy næfre eft on eard ne cuman.

Now I have decided with the councillors who have been with me at Exeter in midwinter, that all [disturbers of the peace] shall be ready to go themselves, with their wives, with their property, and with everything [they possess], whithersoever I wish, unless henceforth they are willing to cease [from wrongdoing]—with the further provision that they never afterwards return to their native district.

Nu hæbbe ic funden mid ðæm witum, ðe æt Eaxceastre mid we wæron to middumwintre, þæt ða ealle syn gearwe mid hire sylfum ⁊ mid yrfe ⁊ mid wife ⁊ mid eallum ðingum to færenne ðider ðider ic ðonne wille—butan hi ofer ðis geswican willan—, on ða gerade ðe heo næfre eft on eorda ne cumen.
